programme.title: 賭城大亨之新哥傳奇
programme.desc: 日軍攻港，大學生賀新（劉德華）與郭英南（萬梓良）同赴澳門逃避戰亂後得賭場大亨（劉兆銘）賞識憑著兩人的聰明才智，很快便出人頭地，正當賀新成為賭王之際，卻遭到王昌的陷害被迫離開澳門，十年後，在香港已有成就的賀新與英南，再度踏上澳門，與賭王之王聶昆聯手爭奪賭權...

programme.title: 賭城大亨II之至尊無敵
programme.desc: 故事緊接賭城大亨之新哥傳奇，重回故鄉並且主持賭場的賀新劉德華，雖賭業興旺，也引來大量老千以高明千術讓賭場大受損失，外加聶昆意欲奪權...一場龍爭虎鬥無法避免...

programme.title: 大人物
programme.desc: 孫大聖（王千源 飾）是重案組的刑警，他大膽無私，奮不顧身地破案有天，一位市民墜樓重傷，大聖很快便懷疑這起案子與大集團的總經理趙泰（包貝爾 飾）有關趙泰無法無天，身邊還有許多保鏢保護著他，這加劇了大聖調查案件的難度但這些都阻止不了大聖，他緊盯趙泰不放，勢必要為受害者討回公道

programme.title: 大宋少年志:30
programme.desc: 慶曆年間，北宋貌似繁華安定的景象下暗潮洶湧，周邊各個割據政權的細作潛伏於汴京城內，窺探大宋軍政祕事北宋為免除戰事，維護各民族間的和平與穩定，借祕閣之名，培訓少年暗探經過嚴密的選拔和審查，詭詐聰慧的元仲辛美貌機敏的趙簡從不殺生的小景絕不說謊的王寬不愛交流的薛映喜歡美女的韋衙內六位少年，因為種種原因，或情願或被迫，組成了祕閣第七齋

programme.title: 殭屍道長:17
programme.desc: 毛小方（林正英飾）帶著徒弟阿帆（容錦昌飾）一生隨路以來宏揚道術，為眾人斬妖除魔，沿路遇上一位女神棍鍾君（苑瓊丹飾）和志同道合的楊飛雲（徐少強飾），豈料鍾君的弟弟鍾邦（王書麒飾）是五世奇人，與千金小姐余碧心（文頌嫻飾）相戀，亦是青梅竹馬，在他們的感情道路上挫折甚多，唯一最大的阻礙就是鍾邦要吃下忘情草才會發揮所有潛能對付更強的妖魔，經多番轉折後才拜毛小方為師，卻因此與姐姐反目

programme.desc: 講述了高中生錢佳玥與母親陳秀娥長期分離導致隔閡，陳彭宇自詡精英卻培養出叛逆的女兒陳末，關愛萍獨自撫養肖涵，小老闆張啟明和愛闖禍的兒子毛頭嘗試相處，展現了四個家庭之間的溫暖故事！

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: Pemuja Rahsia
programme.desc: Adam, pelajar kolej yang popular dan juara debat, gemar menyertai marathon. Hawa, jiran Adam, sudah lama menyukai Adam selepas dia menyelamatkannya daripada lemas 18 tahun lalu. Namun, selepas kematian ayah Hawa, ibu Hawa, Suzana, enggan berhubung rapat dengan keluarga Adam, walaupun ayah Adam, Zul, beberapa kali cuba mendekatinya. Hawa percaya dia dan Adam ditakdirkan bersama, tetapi mereka jarang berkomunikasi. Hawa seorang gadis pendiam, gemar warna hitam, mekap pelik, dan muzik

programme.title: Mr Stalker Saya Cintakan Awaklah!
programme.desc: Ziyan, wartawan Prima Kota marah apabila Nadine membatalkan fotoshoot yang telah dirancang lebih awal. Dia mengejar Nadine untuk mendapatkan berita tentang status pertunangan Nadine. Akibat tekanan perasaan, Nadine pengsan dan dikejarkan ke hospital. Kisya datang menemui Nadine di hospital dan menuduh Nadine merampas cinta Raziq daripadanya.

programme.title: Mr Delicious
programme.desc: Zita, Zara dan Fina bertemu Aiman sewaktu sekolah menengah. Walaupun Aiman pendiam, kehadirannya menarik perhatian mereka bertiga, dan mereka mula memanggilnya Mr Delicious kerana personalitinya yang unik.

programme.title: Sabarlah Duhai Hati
programme.desc: Affan masih tidak mampu menolak permintaan neneknya untuk berkahwin dengan Nadia. Shima tidak mahu bekas suaminya datang sebagai wali ke majlis perkahwinan Nadia. Affan diserang sakit perut, Fira dan Dian membawanya ke hospital untuk pembedahan. Fira telah mendapat persetujuan ibu bapanya untuk menerima lamaran Nazim. Belum sempat berita gembira tersebut dikongsi bersama Nazim, lelaki tersebut membuat keputusan memutuskan perhubungan mereka kerana dia akan bertunang dengan gadis pilihan ibunya.

programme.title: Bidadari Tanpa Syurga
programme.desc: Aisyah mula menyesuaikan diri sebagai isteri kedua. Namun, kehadirannya mencetuskan pelbagai konflik baharu dalam rumah tangga Azlan.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.desc: Molly Djihan Ranti berusaha mencari rezeki dengan menjual jamu segera dalam botol bersama adiknya di kampus demi menampung perbelanjaan harian. Namun, Molly masih bergelut dengan masalah kewangan sehingga sewa biliknya sering tertunggak. Suatu kejadian telah menemukan Molly dengan Vian Julian Jacob, dan hubungan mereka semakin rapat, sekali gus mencetuskan rasa cemburu dalam diri teman wanita Vian.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

programme.title: Forgotten Valley, The
programme.desc: Highly influenced by western culture, couple LUK SHUI-FUNG Raymond Wong and LAW KWAI-SZE Grace Chan want to reshape their feudal hometown, Ping On Valley, which has fallen so far behind, but nothing comes out as they wish. Not only are they under the tyrannical dictatorship of their father, Village Chief LUK KAM-KUK Lau Kong, who constantly stands in their way, but they are also involved in the ghost bride murder mystery, kidnapping and homicide respectively. Victims of bullying including KAM-KUKs concubines SUNG MING-FUNG Louisa So and KOO MAN-YEE Rebecca Zhu, and maid TIN CHOR-YAT Katy Kung eventually cant take it anymore. Defying the status quo in the fight for gender equality, they secretly form an alliance to protect other girls who fall victim to this. Unexpectedly, a group of wicked guys headed by butler NG SHEUNG-SHUN Louis Yuen bring in bandits for their own selfish motives. While blowing the girls cover, it also puts the relationship of SHUI-FUNG and KWAI-SZE to the test, escalating the feud between men and women

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. Cantopop At 50 invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: News Magazine 2026
programme.desc: News Perspective is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: My Family Legacy II
programme.desc: Children take different paths at each stage of life, and parents want to be their strongest support. Is The Family Tradition of Protection an important part of this? Big Brother Sammo Hung founded the Hung Clan, and his son, Timmy Hung, continues his fathers legacy, contributing to the promotion of martial arts films and hoping to pass it on to his son, Hung Tai-yan. Alex Fong inherited his fathers swimming talent, becoming an Olympic swimmer before transitioning to acting and opening a swimming school though the stage may change, the Fong familys beliefs remain unchanged! Liu Yingxuan, raised abroad, has achieved a confident and beautiful life thanks to her parents dedicated nurturing. In this video, she washes and dyes her fathers hair, a former hairstylist, sharing a heartwarming story of father-daughter affection.

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. programme.desc: As the saying goes, Reading ten thousand books is not as good as traveling ten thousand miles. Wayne Lai and Mak Cheung-ching embark on another journey, continuing their exploration of the magnificent landscapes depicted in Jin Yongs novels and delving into the martial arts world of Chinese history. They travel along the Yangtze and Yellow River basins, traversing Sichuan, Zhejiang, Henan, and Shanxi provinces, climbing Mount Emeis Golden Summit, visiting Baidi City, the Yue Fei Temple in Zhuxian Town, and exploring the Shaolin Temple on Mount Song. They experienced the weight of historical sites and savored local delicacies. The martial arts world is not only a stage for swords and shadows, but also a realm of intertwined human relationships. During their journey, they also reunited with Michelle Yim, Benny Chan, Louis Fan, and Jackie Lui, reminiscing about their past collaborations and laughing about bygone days.

programme.title: The Inner Eye Whats On Today
programme.desc: When The Inner Eye follows Shenzhen lawyer Tang Yingying as she handles a series of controversial cases and gradually transforms from someone driven by victory and profit into a lawyer who rediscovers her professional conscience. Through cases involving sexual assault allegations, inheritance disputes, emotional and medical conflicts, domestic violence, and public opinion against lawyers, she witnesses the darkness and vulnerability of human nature. As the lives of Dai Peilin, Lin Xiaoyun, Kang Jun, Fang Weian and others intertwine with hers, Tang learns to cover her eyes and listen to her inner sense of justice and integrity, ultimately finding her own rebirth in law, love and life.

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Reading ten thousand books is not as good as traveling ten thousand miles. Wayne Lai and Mak Cheung-ching embark on another journey, continuing their exploration of the magnificent landscapes depicted in Jin Yongs novels and delving into the martial arts world of Chinese history. They travel along the Yangtze and Yellow River basins, traversing Sichuan, Zhejiang, Henan, and Shanxi provinces, climbing Mount Emeis Golden Summit, visiting Baidi City, the Yue Fei Temple in Zhuxian Town, and exploring the Shaolin Temple on Mount Song. They experienced the weight of historical sites and savored local delicacies. The martial arts world is not only a stage for swords and shadows, but also a realm of intertwined human relationships. During their journey, they also reunited with Michelle Yim, Benny Chan, Louis Fan, and Jackie Lui, reminiscing about their past collaborations and laughing about bygone days.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Walking With You
programme.desc: Sharon Chan, Samantha Ko, Katy Kung, and Grace Chan are close friends in the entertainment industry. This trip to Malaysia was a rare girls getaway, filled with delicious food, fun activities, and experiencing the local culture. During the trip, the four beautiful hosts each invited their friends Lai Lok-yi, Mat Yeung, and Ma Kwun-tung to join them, traveling to Selangor, Pahang, Terengganu, Kelantan, and Sabah. They visited durian orchards to enjoy fresh Musang King durians, picked vegetables and coconuts in vegetable gardens, explored the rainforest, and visited luxurious houses, experiencing a different side of Malaysia. The four friends also shared heartfelt conversations with their guests, revealing their true selves.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: My First of May
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife face devastating trials when their daughter is diagnosed with muscular dystrophy and his mother with cancer. Years later, as the family struggles between holding on and letting go, they find a new connection through a small but powerful sign of hope: the faint movement of their daughters pinky finger.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs and murders the cops. Inspector Bong is devastated to see the aftermath of the carnage and soon discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him. As the two men meet again, it is time to settle the score

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Ready OR Knot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not?

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Lius investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: Love After Love
programme.desc: Directed by Ann Hui, the movie is adapted from Eileen Changs first short story. Set in 1930s, Wei Long travels to Hong Kong from Shanghai to pursue her education. Struggling financially, she asks her aunt to help pay for tuition but ends up being her aunts puppet to lure rich men. When Wei Long falls for playboy, George, she sinks into a life of depravity.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, its cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kongs social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeepers daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King Liu Chung-chun teams up with Goddess of Mercy Chao Li-chuan and the Dragon Girl Lung Nu to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh Ting Hua-chung,son of the Ox Demon Hung Hai-erh to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim Teng Chio-jen.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brothers Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tiens gang is helping them he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperors plot once again.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his sons arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: Love Story
programme.desc: A Christian Zumba instructor falls in love with a starry-eyed upper caste Hindu girl. In their quest for happiness, however, they must first overcome a massive caste divide.

programme.title: Rekka
programme.desc: A young man, known for helping couples elope, is forced by a gangster to kidnap a politicians daughter after he stops the wedding of a girl who didnt want to marry him.

programme.title: Aadhar
programme.desc: Pharsua becomes the first villager to get an Aadhaar card, but when a superstition links its number to his wifes fate, he embarks on a comic quest to change it.

programme.title: Mersal
programme.desc: Maaran, is falsely arrested for the murder of his colleague, Dr Arjun Zachariah. He soon discovers that the real culprit is a lookalike who aims to expose corruption in the medical industry.

programme.title: Rajini Murugan
programme.desc: Rajini Murugan, an unemployed youth, falls in love with Karthika, his cousin. But Karthikas father opposes the match.

programme.title: Thirunaal
programme.desc: Blade, a henchman for a local gangster, Naaga, falls in love with Vidhya, the daughter of a factory owner. He has to choose between supporting her father and his boss, who are rivals.

programme.title: When I was Your Age

And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 帶領香港科技園多年的香港科技園前董事局主席查毅超，上任新田科技城主席，他接受大鳴大放專訪，表示新田科技城與科學園河套港深創科園洪水橋等各有分工，新田科技城主打中下游產業，目標為香港工業GDP做好產值查毅超指出創科產業生態鏈中，科學園主力上游研究與開發，現時科學園有2600間科技公司，當中1200間是初創公司，佔比是全港5000間初創企業的四分一；工作人口26000人，當中11000人是進行研究與開發，佔全港研究與開發專才的四分一人口河套港深創科園則主力生態鏈中的上中游中試等，特別專注在生命科技發展查毅超詳解中游是指中試，在研究階段的小批量試產；洪水橋主攻先進物流業及先進物流工業至於佔地210公頃的新田科技城，打造中下游產業，與先進製造業有關例如微電子新材料綠色科技或生命科技產業，查毅超強調：新田科技城會對香港工業GDP有貢獻查毅超又指出，政府在很多政策上做到拆牆鬆綁，加快園區發展：我沒有想過在我有生之年，這樣拆牆鬆綁，開通思維，令我眼界大開他舉例平整土地可直接找第三方協助，在原有的規劃上拆牆鬆綁，創科局的高層與園方都是以目標為本，加快發展，令香港的創科發展更具競爭力查毅超表示沙嶺的超算中心便是一個例子，過往香港地價高令發展或投資創科企業卻步，但政府在政策上做到拆牆鬆綁，沙嶺的地價相對深汕工業地，是有競爭力；他指新田科技城與客戶洽談時，亦以沙嶺的靈活性為指標香港的大學基礎研究人才充足，今年６月起香港幾間大學排名晉身全球60強查毅超期望政府將來推出稅務改革，吸引高科技企業落戶香港

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 安全扣爆開，我就意外從七樓墮地，昏迷了一個月，真的十分驚險，幸運地可以撿回一命搭棚師傅陳先生，前年十二月和一名同事於大廈外牆，搭建俗稱吊棚的懸空式竹棚時，意外墮地受傷，導致身體多個地方骨折，至今仍未完全康復根據建築地盤安全規例，工期少於六星期工人數目少於十人的建築工程，動工時是獲豁免不需要向勞工處呈報，然而這類工程的意外傷亡事件時有發生，申訴專員公署於去年發表調查報告，指於2018至2023年期間，有兩成七的致命工業意外，正是按法例毋須呈報的裝修及維修工程勞工及福利局於五年前曾提出修例建議，要求四項高風險的相關工程須要呈報，然而時至今日，修訂仍未落實，呈報和巡查是掛鉤的，沒有呈報的話，有人會以僥倖心態看待，往往釀成十分嚴重的工業意外立法會議員周小松認為，政府應盡快修例，提高對工友安全保障 當匹克球仍被視為一項新興運動，三十歲的林浚禧Ryan已經是一位全職匹克球運動員他自小打網球和乒乓球，三年前，在公園看到有人打匹克球，覺得很有趣，於是便下場試玩，豈料這一試，改變了他的人生方向，決定辭職去打匹克球，更曾於世界性比賽排名世界第一，亦代表香港出戰匹克球世界盃，獲得男子雙打亞軍他是如何走上全職匹克球運動員之路？在沒有場地和教練的情況下，他又如何登上世界盃的舞台？

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.
